title: Metric-driven self-improvement loop — target architecture (project-agnostic)
summary: The self-learning loop is being extended from test-pass/rationale judging into a metric-driven optimization loop that works on ANY target repo (the orchestrator's own source AND client projects), not just the daemon workspace. Cycle: direction(+inline metric & measure command) → plan → build multiple rival solutions (exists) → MEASURE metric in each worktree → JUDGE by intelligently weighting tradeoffs across attempts vs baseline AND vs competitor/industry-average benchmark (researched when available) → record learning → propose next change → iterate. Stop on diminishing returns + token budget; escalate when stuck/ambiguous.
